Additional Notes

  • Marie-Agnes Project: https://themarieagnesproject.com/

THINK OF VISITING MARIE AGNES YOURSELF? MAYBE YOU CAN FIND THOSE TIPS HELPFUL. BUT FIRST OF ALL… Forget the fins! Marie Agnes is a very specific dive site. Narrow corridors make it almost impossible to navigate using fins. We suggest to dive with using a French configuration - weight belts and 2 side cylinders rather than classical sidemount harness or twin setup. Please keep in mind that although small, this object can be very dangerous due to extremely quickly dropping visibility and narrow passages, so enter only if full-cave certified.
